name: Found a Wallet
description: You find a wallet on the street with $50 inside and an ID. What do you do?

choices.outcome: You returned the wallet. The owner was grateful, and your reputation improved.
You kept the $50 but felt guilty about it.

choices.text: Hand it in to the police
choices.outcome: You handed the wallet in to the police. A responsible choice.

name: Unexpected Bonus
description: Your employer surprises everyone with a small bonus at the end of the month.

name: Old Friend Reaches Out
description: Someone you lost touch with sends you a message out of the blue. How do you respond?

choices.outcome: You rekindled an old friendship. Your happiness increased.
You replied politely but didn't invest much time.
You chose not to respond. The opportunity passed.

name: Minor Illness
description: You come down with a cold and spend a few days resting.

name: Community Event
description: Your neighbourhood is hosting a community clean-up day. Will you join?

choices.outcome: You volunteered and felt great about contributing. Reputation improved.
You stayed home but watched the event from your window.
